description: Work with ZIP archives locally. action "create": zip files and folders (given as paths; folders keep their own name as the top folder, symlinks are skipped) into one .zip. action "extract": unpack a .zip (path or base64) into the "output" folder; entries with "..", absolute paths or drive letters are refused (zip-slip protection), existing files are kept unless overwrite is true. action "list": entry names with sizes, no extraction. Limits: total uncompressed size 500 MB and 10000 files by default (maxTotalMB / maxFiles). Encrypted ZIPs are not supported.

files.description: create: files and folders to add (local paths).

maxFiles.description: Cap on the number of entries. Default 10000.

maxTotalMB.description: Cap on the total uncompressed size, MB. Default 500.

output.description: create: the .zip path (or a folder ending in "/"). extract: the folder to extract into. Default: the server output folder.

overwrite.description: extract: replace files that already exist in the output folder. Default false (they are skipped).

zip.description: extract / list: the ZIP archive, a local path or base64.

name: ai_zip
title: ZIP create / extract / list
